'''Clue scroll (elite)''' is an [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Anagrams|anagram clue]] obtained during [[Treasure Trails]]. It states ''"This anagram reveals who to speak to next: Cirr Jad"''

The player is required to speak to [[Jardric]] on [[Fossil Island]].

{{Bug|It is possible to hold this clue step at the same time as another elite clue step. Completing this step right after completing a different elite treasure trail and receiving an elite casket will result in this clue completing the new treasure trail in 1 step, as it preserves your progress on the clue still in your inventory. WARNING: Holding 2 or more jardic steps when speaking to jardic will delete all but one.}}
